background: Keep the legacy /v1/charge endpoint for the mobile app, or cut it?
intuitive: The old payment endpoint is still used by app versions we cannot force anyone to update.
why: Cutting it breaks anyone who has not updated the app in six months - about 3% of traffic.
rec: Keep it read-only for one more release and log every caller, so the next decision has numbers.

intuitive: A ticket number that makes sending the same request twice do the work only once.
technical: A client-supplied unique string the server stores with the result, so a retried request returns the first outcome instead of performing the action again.
